messages:
marta (Finance Ops): Heads up — March invoice batch produced a couple of odd cases. ACME (acct_acme) got two invoices and is missing the reserved-capacity proration line. Contour had a vendor credit applied twice. Can someone help triage?

oliver (Billing Eng): Can you drop the invoice ids + a quick export? I'll grep the billing job logs. ping @liam for ETL context. :eyes: 

marta (Finance Ops): Invoice IDs: inv_2034_0301_acme and inv_2034_0301_acme-dup. Contour: inv_2034_0301_ctr. Sample ledger snippet from export: 
```json
{"acct":"acct_acme","lines":[],"credits":[{"id":"vcred_55","amount":-500}]}
```

oliver (Billing Eng): Thanks. Preliminary guess: proration step may have filtered-out zero-usage lines, leaving an empty lines array, and a downstream retry created a duplicate invoice row. Adding this to billing-engine queue.

liam (Data Eng): I pulled the ETL run around 2025-03-01 00:15 UTC — saw the exporter log `billing_exporter: skipped_line if usage_amount==0` and then a DB write retry for the same batch uuid. That sequence could explain both the missing line and duplicate invoice creation. I'll re-run the extract for affected accounts.

tara (CS): ACME already opened a support ticket — they see two PDFs and one is missing the reserved capacity line. Please pause automated payment dunning for acct_acme and let CS know ETA.

oliver (Billing Eng): I can create reversal credit and regenerate the corrected invoice PDF. Need finance approval to void inv_2034_0301_acme-dup before issuing corrected docs. @marta? :pray: 

marta (Finance Ops): Approved to void the duplicate. Please attach a short explanation note in the PDF cover and flag for manual review. I'll coordinate the customer message.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: billing-engine release v3.7.2 deployed at 2025-03-01T00:10:21Z — possible correlation with the new filter.

oliver (Billing Eng): Root cause appears to be the recent PR `filter-empty-prorated-lines` (PR #688). I'll open a rollback PR and add a regression test that covers zero-usage buckets + retry path.

marta (Finance Ops): Action items: 1) liam re-run ETL for ACME/Contour; 2) oliver void duplicate + generate corrected PDF; 3) tara send updated CS note to ACME; 4) oliver open rollback PR & test. Goal: get corrected PDFs and customer note by EOD.

tara (CS): Thanks — I'll standby and update the ticket once PDFs are posted.
